new_exact_result: For any true U in U(4), any row pair I={i,j}, and any embedded G in U(2), after replacing a_i,a_j by their mean m in N, det(diag(a)+G U diag(b) U* G*) = d0 + delta sum_{r=x,y,z} q_r n_r, where delta=(a_i-a_j)/2, H_G=G* sigma_z G=n dot sigma, d0=det N-delta^2 det N[I^c,I^c], and q_r=tr(adj(N) tilde_sigma_r). Thus the whole pair orbit is a filled complex ellipse and its support maximum is Re(eta d0)+|| (Re(eta delta q_r))_r ||_2. The column-pair analogue is identical with a,b interchanged.
global_maximizer_consequence: Every global support maximizer must simultaneously be the north-pole maximizer of six row-pair and six column-pair ellipses: each transverse support coefficient vanishes and the longitudinal coefficient is nonnegative.
